spec_atomic_units: The outputs p and q are dependent on the inputs 'clock' and 'a'.
When clock = 0 and a = 0, then p = 0 and q = 0.
When clock = 0 and a = 1, then p = 0 and q = 0.
When clock = 1 and a = 0, then p = 0 and q = 0.
When clock = 1 and a = 1, then p = 1 and q = 0.
When clock = 0 and a = 1, then p = 1 and q = 1.
When clock = 1 and a = 0, then p = 0 and q = 1.
When clock = 1 and a = 1, then p = 1 and q = 1.
The outputs `p` and `q` change only on the positive edge of `clock`.
The value of `a` at the positive edge of `clock` determines the next value of `p`.
The value of `p` at the negative edge of `clock` determines the next value of `q`.
p is updated with the value of `a` at each positive clock edge.
q is updated with the value of `p` at each negative clock edge.
